sql: select r.id, r.respondent_name, r.approval_status, r.candidate_stage, r.distance_km, r.source, to_char(r.created_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') as criado, to_char(r.approved_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') as aprovado_em, r.whatsapp_sent_at is not null as msg_enviada, r.whatsapp_send_error from freelancer_responses r join freelancer_templates t on t.id = r.template_id where t.purpose = 'candidatura' order by r.created_at desc
